description: Miniapp Expert Pack invariants — WeChat/Alipay mini-program domain rules

invariants.name: openid_must_not_be_trusted_without_server_validation
invariants.description: openid/user identity from miniapp client must be validated server-side before granting access to user data

invariants.name: session_token_required_for_user_actions
invariants.description: All user actions (submit, pay, upload, view own data) must carry a valid server-issued session token

invariants.name: user_cannot_access_other_user_data
invariants.description: Server must enforce that user A cannot read/write user B data regardless of client-side restrictions

invariants.name: miniapp_secret_never_exposed_to_client
invariants.description: AppSecret, API keys, payment keys, and any server-side secrets must never appear in miniapp frontend code or config files distributed to client

invariants.name: payment_callback_must_be_idempotent
invariants.description: Payment callback handlers must tolerate duplicate calls — idempotency key or transaction ID dedup required

invariants.name: upload_file_type_must_be_validated
invariants.description: Server must validate uploaded file MIME type and extension against an allowlist. Client-side check alone is insufficient.

invariants.name: upload_size_limit_enforced
invariants.description: Server must enforce maximum upload size per file and per request. Client-side limits are hints only.

invariants.name: form_input_must_be_validated
invariants.description: All form inputs must be validated server-side for type, length, range, and format. Client validation is not sufficient.

invariants.name: admin_api_requires_permission
invariants.description: Admin backend APIs for miniapp content management must be behind role-based access control, not just a shared admin token
required_tests: unauthorized admin API access rejection test

invariants.name: production_appid_requires_human_review
invariants.description: Switching miniapp from dev AppID to production AppID must trigger human review — production config has real user data implications

non_claims: This pack does NOT constitute a complete production miniapp
This pack does NOT handle WeChat/Alipay platform review/approval
This pack does NOT include real payment gateway integration (only design patterns)
This pack is a DESIGN AID — domain rules, invariants, and test patterns
